name: 12054 · Delmar, NY
findings: ZIP 12054 (Delmar) has 92 nonprofit organizations. 59 of them (64%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 55 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (18% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 12054 (Delmar) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 12054 (Delmar) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 3.1 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 55 organizations here; 17% of all organizations here have no identified type.
